title: Text: DET R.J. Burgess ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: My guy Drew Carlton from FSU is listed as the 38th backup minor league emergency pitcher today in the big league game...Can you let me know how he does if by some miracle he gets in the game?
We’ve got some good ones coming up the pike
I heard Faedo was back up to 94 last week in a mini camp game. We get that one figured out too we’ll be in good shape
